column1: //ORDER POLICY
Order Policy: Orders are processed within 24 hours and shipped within 2–3 business days.
Order Policy: Pre-orders may take 7–14 days depending on supplier availability.
Order Policy: Orders placed after 6 PM will be processed the next business day.
Order Policy: High-demand items may require additional verification before shipping.
Order Policy: Orders cannot be combined once placed.
Order Policy: Items in the same order may ship from different warehouses.
Order Policy: Out-of-stock items will automatically be backordered.
Order Policy: Gift orders do not include price details on the invoice.
Order Policy: Bulk orders may require 2–4 extra processing days.
Order Policy: Orders may be delayed due to weather, fuel issues, or courier delays.
Order Policy: Signature may be required upon delivery for high-value items.
//RETURN POLICY
Return Policy: Most items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.
Return Policy: Returned items must be in original packaging with all accessories.
Return Policy: Return pickup will be scheduled within 2–3 business days.
Return Policy: Perishable items and gift cards are non-returnable.
Return Policy: A restocking fee may apply for opened electronics.
Return Policy: Apparel can be exchanged for size within 15 days.
Return Policy: Refunds are initiated only after quality inspection.
//REFUND TIMELINE
Refund Timeline: Refunds take 5–7 business days to appear in your bank account.
Refund Timeline: Card refunds may take 7–10 working days depending on the bank.
Refund Timeline: Refund status can be tracked under 'Refund Details'.
//REPLACEMENT POLICY
Replacement Policy: Replacements are issued for damaged or defective items after approval.
//SHIPPING POLICY (Sri Lanka)
Shipping: Free shipping on orders above Rs. 15,000.
Shipping: Express delivery available for an extra fee.
Shipping: International shipping takes 7–12 business days.
Shipping: Tracking numbers are generated within 24 hours after dispatch.
Shipping: Weekend deliveries depend on local courier availability.
Shipping: Delays may occur during holidays or peak seasons.
Shipping: Fragile items are shipped with extra protective packaging.
Shipping: PO box addresses may not be eligible for all couriers.
Shipping: Cash on Delivery is not available for express shipping.
Shipping: Split shipments may occur due to multiple warehouse locations.
Shipping: Courier partners will retry delivery up to 3 times.
//PAYMENT METHODS (Sri Lanka-Adjusted)
Payment Methods: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, and Cash on Delivery.
Payment Methods: Apple Pay and Google Pay are supported.
Payment Methods: Bank transfers available for major Sri Lankan banks.
Payment Methods: EMI is available for orders above Rs. 60,000.
Payment Methods: Pay Later options available for eligible customers.
Payment Methods: Failed payments may require browser cache clearing.
Payment Methods: International cards are accepted.
Payment Methods: COD is limited to orders under Rs. 90,000.
Payment Methods: Wallet payments like FriMi and Genie allow instant refunds.
Payment Methods: UPI payment methods supported where available.
//WARRANTY
Warranty: Electronics include a 1-year manufacturer warranty.
Warranty: Accessories include a 6-month limited warranty.
Warranty: Refurbished products include a 6-month seller warranty.
Warranty: Warranty does not cover physical or accidental damage.
Warranty: Customers must register products to activate extended warranty.
Warranty: Warranty claims require the purchase invoice.
//CANCELLATION POLICY
Cancellation Policy: Orders can be canceled within 2 hours after placing.
Cancellation Policy: Pre-orders can be canceled before production starts.
Cancellation Policy: Subscription renewals can be canceled anytime.
Cancellation Policy: Cancellations are not allowed once shipped.
Cancellation Policy: COD orders may require phone verification to cancel.
//ORDER TRACKING
Track Order Instructions: Go to 'My Orders' → Enter order ID → View live updates.
Track Order Instructions: SMS updates are sent at each delivery stage.
Track Order Instructions: Email notifications are sent once delivered.
//CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Customer Support Hours: Support available 24/7 via chat.
Customer Support Hours: Phone support available 9AM–6PM on business days.
Customer Support Hours: Email responses may take 12–24 hours.
//DAMAGED PRODUCT POLICY
Damaged Product Policy: Customers must upload a photo of the damage for quick replacement.
Damaged Product Policy: Claims must be filed within 48 hours of delivery.
Damaged Product Policy: Replacement approval typically takes 24–48 hours.
Damage Claim Policy: Missing items must be reported within 24 hours.

//TROUBLESHOOTING
Troubleshooting: If an order is stuck at 'Processing', the seller has not confirmed it.
Troubleshooting: If payment fails, try another method or clear browser cache.
Troubleshooting: For delayed deliveries, contact support with your order ID.
Troubleshooting: App crashing? Update or reinstall the app.
Troubleshooting: Login issues? Use the 'Forgot Password' option.
Troubleshooting: Tracking shows 'Exception'? Contact courier or support.
Troubleshooting: If product is missing, report within 24 hours.
Troubleshooting: If the page isn't loading, try refreshing or switching networks.
Troubleshooting: COD not appearing? Item may not be eligible.
Troubleshooting: Refund not received? Check bank processing times.
//FAQ (Sri Lanka Version — EXACT FORMAT YOU WANT)
FAQ: Can I change my delivery address? Yes, within the first 12 hours.
FAQ: Do you offer student discounts? Yes, 10% off on electronics.
FAQ: What happens if I miss a delivery? It will be re-attempted the next business day.
FAQ: Do you offer gift wrapping? Yes, available for Rs. 900 per item.
FAQ: Can I schedule a delivery? Yes, selected items support scheduled delivery.
FAQ: Are gift cards refundable? No, gift cards are non-refundable.
FAQ: Can I exchange a product? Yes, exchanges allowed within 15 days.
FAQ: Do refurbished items have warranty? Yes, 6-month warranty included.
FAQ: Can I track my refund? Yes, via 'Refund Details' in your account.
FAQ: Is COD available for all products? Only for orders under Rs. 90,000.
FAQ: Are international shipments insured? Yes, at no extra cost.
